description: Contract claims PROP-AUTH-018 is 'tested (via handleAuthRequest; Set-Cookie header contains required attributes)' but the actual test at auth-flow.test.ts:277-288 does NOT call handleAuthRequest. It calls saveDiscordLinkSession directly and asserts getStoreCounts().linkSessions > 0. This test verifies store insertion, not Set-Cookie header attributes for __Host-link_session. Furthermore, handleAuthRequest for /v1/auth/discord/callback (shell/index.ts:147-149) does not emit a Set-Cookie header for __Host-link_session at all, so even calling handleAuthRequest would not verify this PROP. The contract's status description is inaccurate relative to the actual test coverage.
